channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English
channel.description: English fact summaries of Japanese corporate filings from EDINET.

item.title: JTEKT Corporation: JTEKT launches tender offer to buy back up to 11,000,100 own shares at ¥1,733.
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-26 to 2026-12-23 (20 business days). | Offer price: JPY 1,733 per share, a 10% discount to the 2026-11-24 closing price of JPY 1,925.0. | Planned purchase: 11,000,000 shares (3.45%); upper limit 11,000,100 shares (3.46%). | Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki-gaisha holds 77,235,087 shares (24.26%) and has indicated it will tender 10,000,000 shares (3.14%); no tender agreement has been signed. | Upper limit on total acquisition amount: JPY 19,063,173,300; 9,500,000 acquired shares are planned for cancellation after the offer. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)
